project.title: Standardise Payroll and Office Documentation Workflow
project.objective: Design and roll out a unified, compliant workflow for payroll processing and office document handling to reduce errors and improve turnaround time.
deliverables: Standard operating procedure for document intake and archiving
Shared payroll and document tracking sheet
Access and confidentiality guideline for payroll and HR docs
Checklist for monthly payroll close and reconciliations
constraints: All workflows must comply with tax and labour regulations
No new paid software tools; use existing office suite only
Go-live within current quarter with at least one full payroll cycle
Maintain information confidentiality at all stages
Minimal disruption to ongoing payroll and office operations

risks.risk: Incorrect interpretation of tax or labour rules in the new workflow.
risks.mitigation: Have HR and finance manager review all payroll steps and sign off before go-live.

risks.risk: Staff resist changing existing informal document handling habits.
risks.mitigation: Run short training sessions, share clear checklists, and gather feedback for quick adjustments.

risks.risk: Data loss or misfiling during migration to the new archiving structure.
risks.mitigation: Pilot with a single month of data, keep backups of old folders, and validate samples after migration.

risks.risk: Tight payroll deadlines cause partial adoption of the new process.
risks.mitigation: Phase rollout over two cycles and keep a fallback path documented for urgent cases.

themes.why_relevant: Core objective is to make each payroll run consistent, traceable, and on time.
Office clerks must route forms and correspondence correctly to support payroll accuracy.
Payroll and HR documents contain sensitive data that must be protected.
Team needs a shared way to log, trace, and fix discrepancies in wages and records.
New workflows must be easy to adopt by current and future clerical staff.

backlog.task: Map current payroll processing steps from data collection to payment confirmation
definition_of_done: All existing payroll steps listed in sequence
Inputs, outputs, and responsible roles documented
Bottlenecks and manual rework points highlighted
Shared with office clerks and finance manager for review

backlog.task: Design standard template for staff absence and overtime reporting
definition_of_done: Template created using existing office tools
Fields cover absences, overtime, and approvals
Reviewed by payroll clerks for completeness
Stored in shared location and link communicated
Checklist includes data collection, validation, tax calculation, and approvals
Steps ordered by due date relative to pay day
Reviewed by internal auditor or finance manager
Published as official reference for each payroll run

backlog.task: Define document routing rules for incoming HR and payroll-related correspondence
definition_of_done: List of document types and their destination roles created
Rules for urgent vs standard items defined
Routing rules validated with payroll clerks and HR
Guideline shared with all office clerks

backlog.task: Set up shared payroll and document tracking sheet
definition_of_done: Sheet structure created with status, owner, and due date fields
Access granted to relevant clerks and managers
Sample data from last payroll cycle entered
Team agrees to use sheet as single tracking source

backlog.task: Draft confidentiality and access guideline for payroll documents
definition_of_done: Guideline covers storage, sharing, and retention rules
Access levels defined for each document type
Reviewed by HR and internal auditor
Final version stored in shared policy folder

backlog.task: Standardise digital archiving structure for payroll and HR documents
definition_of_done: Folder structure and naming conventions defined
Examples provided for at least three recent months
Payroll clerks confirm structure supports their reporting
Archiving checklist created for monthly use

backlog.task: Pilot new workflow on one payroll cycle and log issues
definition_of_done: New workflow used for a full payroll run
All deviations and issues logged in tracking sheet
Post-cycle review held with office clerks
List of adjustments agreed and documented

backlog.task: Create quick reference guide for office clerks on payroll-related forms
definition_of_done: Guide lists each form, purpose, and required fields
Includes routing and expected processing time
Validated by at least one payroll clerk
Shared in channel and stored with other guidelines

backlog.task: Align invoice issuing process with new document workflow
definition_of_done: Touchpoints between invoices and payroll identified
Steps for issuing and archiving invoices documented
Consistency with accounting conventions checked
Process approved by finance manager

backlog.task: Define escalation path for discrepancies in wages or hours
definition_of_done: Scenarios for common discrepancies listed
Escalation contacts and response times defined
Shared with office clerks handling staff queries
Included in monthly payroll close checklist

backlog.task: Prepare short training session outline for new workflow
definition_of_done: Agenda and key topics drafted
Includes demos of templates and tracking sheet
Reviewed by a payroll clerk for accuracy
Slides or handout stored in shared folder

artifacts.title: Document Routing and Archiving Rules
artifacts.used_for: Guide office clerks on where to send and how to file incoming documents.

artifacts.title: Monthly Payroll Close Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Ensure all required steps are completed before confirming payroll.

artifacts.title: Confidentiality and Access Policy for Payroll Docs
artifacts.used_for: Define who can access which documents and how to handle sensitive data.

artifacts.title: Office Clerks Quick Reference on Payroll Forms
artifacts.used_for: Help office clerks correctly handle and route payroll-related forms.

artifacts.title: Pilot Cycle Issue Log
artifacts.used_for: Record issues found during the first run of the new workflow and their fixes.

artifacts.title: Escalation Path for Payroll Discrepancies
artifacts.used_for: Standardise how discrepancies in wages or hours are escalated and resolved.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current-state mapping and target payroll workflow design.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking for everyone to share how they currently process payroll and related documents.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the official sequence of steps for the standard payroll workflow.
Confirm which roles own each step in the new workflow.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define document routing, archiving structure, and templates.
threads_plan.trigger: Office clerk posts draft routing rules and asks for feedback from payroll clerks.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the standard document routing rules for payroll-related items.
Select the final versions of the absence and overtime templates.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in confidentiality, access levels, and escalation paths.
threads_plan.trigger: Payroll clerk shares draft confidentiality guideline and escalation path for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve confidentiality and access rules for payroll documents.
Agree on the standard escalation path for payroll discrepancies.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Prepare and execute the pilot payroll cycle using the new workflow.
threads_plan.trigger: Message announcing the pilot cycle and asking everyone to confirm readiness.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the payroll cycle that will be used as the pilot for the new workflow.
Agree on success criteria and what must be logged during the pilot.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in where each participant posts what they did, blockers, and next steps.
Weekly summary message consolidating decisions, updated artifacts, and upcoming deadlines.
Post-pilot mini-retrospective thread to capture what worked, what did not, and proposed changes.
On each payroll close, quick confirmation thread to tick off items from the payroll close checklist.
